# VHS

A worn VHS tape: wobbling lines, colors bleeding to the right of edges, a rolling tracking band, head-switching noise at the bottom and a PLAY display with a tape counter.

<EffectDemo effect="vhs" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { vhs } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/vhs';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(vhs({ preset: 'rental' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.wobble = 0.5`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter         | Type    | Default | Range     | Description                                                             |
| ----------------- | ------- | ------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `wobble`          | number  | `0.5`   | 0 – 2     | Horizontal wobble of the tape.                                          |
| `bleed`           | number  | `6`     | 0 – 24 px | How far colors smear to the right.                                      |
| `saturation`      | number  | `0.85`  | 0 – 1.5   | Color strength after the tape.                                          |
| `tracking`        | number  | `0.5`   | 0 – 1     | Strength of the rolling tracking band.                                  |
| `headSwitching`   | number  | `0.6`   | 0 – 1     | Skew and noise in the bottom lines.                                     |
| `noise`           | number  | `0.3`   | 0 – 1     | Luma noise.                                                             |
| `onScreenDisplay` | boolean | `true`  |           | Show PLAY and a tape counter.                                           |
| `seed`            | integer | `0`     | 0 – 9999  | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                         |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rental`    | `wobble: 1`, `tracking: 0.8`, `noise: 0.5`                       |
| `clean`     | `wobble: 0.2`, `tracking: 0`, `noise: 0.1`, `headSwitching: 0.2` |
| `faded`     | `saturation: 0.5`, `bleed: 12`                                   |
| `noDisplay` | `onScreenDisplay: false`                                         |

Apply one with `vhs({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`tracking: 0`, `noise: 0`, `wobble: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Cost:** 86.7 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 8.7 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/vhs`, including the shared effect runtime.
